posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel EP1: Bablu works 16 hours, Kaka says money leaks from three places
lines: Solah ghante kaam... phir bhi paisa kahan gaya?
Beta, tera hotel guest nahi kho raha... paisa teen jagah se leak ho raha hai. Teen jagah se, Kaka?
Ek, haath ke bill. Do, kitchen ki parchiyan. Teen, store ka maal, jiska koi hisaab nahi.
Sab ek screen pe daal.
Bill khud GST lagaye,
order seedha kitchen jaaye,
aur stock khud ghate.
Kaka, aaj aath baje ghar! Shabaash, beta!

posts.story: Bablu ka Hotel EP3 haazri: staff call in absent, paper attendance register is a mess, Kaka shows phone clock-in, leave queue, payslips and documents in your own Drive (HR4U)
posts.hook: Stop counting staff in a register.
lines: Kaun aaya, kaun nahi... is register se kuch pata hi nahi chalta!
Beta, register band kar.
Staff phone se haazri lagaye,
Good morning sir! Haazri lag gayi.
chhutti bhi phone se maange...
aur salary slip, ek click mein.
Aur saare kagaz... contract, ID, salary slip... sab teri apni Google Drive mein, beta.
Ab pata hai kaun aaya, kaun nahi. Mahine ke aakhir mein, bas ek click!
